feature_transforms.matched_roots: c = number of atoms matching the query

replay_recipe: x_i = features from ast_tree (values are c, p=c/n_atoms, e=1[c>0], log1p(c)); columns follow feature_names; margin = base_score + sum over trees of leaf value reached with 'value < split_condition' (float32, left child if true); prediction_raw = margin * target_scaler.std + target_scaler.mean

selected_state.selection_rule: minimum Val RMSE over H1/H2 and all rounds; ties H1 then earlier
